prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original OpenSamguk raster game terrain sprites. Create a precisely aligned transparent PNG atlas of FIVE flat 2:1 dimetric diamond ground tiles, each in its own row, vertically stacked with generous transparent gutters. All diamonds same exact size and projection, full opaque texture inside diamond and genuine alpha-zero outside. Five rows top to bottom: 1 muted olive grass with sparse ochre bare earth, 2 dark olive forest floor with fine leaf litter and no trees, 3 weathered warm gray rocky ground with tiny gravel and no raised mountains, 4 subdued blue-teal river water with fine subtle ripples filling entire diamond and NO banks, 5 darker desaturated blue deep water with understated fine ripples. Classical late-1990s pre-rendered historical RTS visual language, realistic fine granular texture, muted olive/ochre/gray/teal palette as in a Three Kingdoms battlefield, overhead upper-left illumination. These are flat ground texture planes only. All straight edges, equal diamond footprint width exactly twice height, horizontal left/right tips and centered top/bottom tips. Suggested canvas 1024 wide by 1536 tall, diamonds width896 height448 would not fit five rows; instead use canvas1024x1536 with each diamond512x256 centered horizontally, centers y156,462,768,1074,1380, separated50px. No text, labels, UI, borders, shadows outside footprint, extruded sides, thick slab, podium, perspective horizon, trees, units, buildings or scenery. Retain transparent empty padding. Render five separate usable ground textures, not a scene.
